narr: Periodic storms ahead of and along a slow-moving cold front produced mainly hail across North Texas March 4th through 6th. A short-lived landspout was observed in Ellis County near Forreston on the 5th. Additional rounds of showers and storms formed to our west and moved east over the 6th through the 8th, producing hail and damaging wind gusts.
ev: Highway 377 from Westport Parkway to Ridge Point Parkway was closed due to high water.
lsr: Highway 377 from Westport Parkway to Ridge Point Parkway closed, traffic being rerouted.
